verdict.text: The incident is found, fixed and written up, but not closed: one action in the postmortem has no owner. The cause was a parser removed with its test in 49bc16d.

blocks.text: **Rule:** The chain is done when the postmortem exists, validates, and every action on it has an owner and a date; an action without one is an open item.. **Answer:** no, owner missing.

items: Give the alerting action an owner and a date, then the postmortem is complete.
Re-import the 1,340 orders from the kept export files, as triage's mitigation said.
